svg.title: StageInputs for one step
svg.text: Transformer::StageInputs: one step's inputs in the pinned buffer inputs_host_
Engine step 4 of murmur-lab schedule: Mei decodes 1 token, Kenji decodes 1 token, Aiko runs 23 prompt tokens.
row_cache[row] = pages[position >> 4] << 4 | (position & 15): e.g. row 2, position 18: pages[1] = 7, so 7 << 4 | 2 = 114.
one slot per decode row first, then one slot per prompt chunk
per slot: its page table and context; per row: token, position, cache row, slot
logit_rows: the last `logits` rows of each entry, in entry order
